tagline: Leading midstream energy company serving the Appalachian Basin
hero_kpi_rationale: Capex is a key indicator of investment in energy infrastructure and future production capacity to support growth in gathering and processing operations.

kpis.name: Capital Expenditures
kpis.description: Investments in energy infrastructure to support growth, including gathering systems, processing facilities, and water handling systems

kpis.name: Gathering Systems and Facilities
kpis.explanation: Investments in gathering systems and facilities
kpis.description: Investments in gathering systems and facilities for natural gas gathering in the Appalachian Basin

kpis.name: Water Handling Systems
kpis.description: Investments in water handling systems including underground pipelines, storage facilities, and pumping stations

kpis.name: 2026 Investment Budget
kpis.description: Investment budget for 2026 reflecting the closing of the HG acquisition and the potential sale of the Utica Shale portion

risks.title: Dependence on Antero Resources
risks.score_rationale: The company is highly dependent on Antero Resources for its revenues and cash flows. Any event affecting Antero Resources could materially impact revenues and operating results

risks.title: Commodity Price Volatility
risks.score_rationale: Commodity prices can fluctuate significantly and affect drilling and extraction activities at Antero Resources, indirectly impacting volumes and revenues

risks.title: FERC Regulatory Risks
risks.score_rationale: The classification of gathering facilities could be changed by FERC, potentially subjecting the facilities to federal tariff regulation

risks.title: Geopolitical and Regulatory Risks
risks.score_rationale: Regulatory changes and geopolitical events could affect operations and revenues

risks.title: Counterparty Credit Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to counterparty credit risk related to non-payment or non-performance by Antero Resources under its service agreements

ai_positioning.summary: Antero Midstream Corporation does not mention artificial intelligence, machine learning, or related technologies in its 2025 Form 10-K. No references to AI are present in the provided excerpts.
